annotations.title: Rename, move or share folders and assets

description: Rename, move and/or change the sharing of folders and assets, up to 20 items per call, each with its own result. Per item: id (a folder id, an asset id, or a version id) plus at least one of: title (renames the folder, or the asset; a version id renames its asset), version_title (names that one version, as in the app's version list; version ids only), folder_id (move into this folder, or "root" for the team's top level; a version id moves its whole asset), link_access (what anyone with the item's link can do: comment_and_notes (comment and read version notes and files), comment, view, or none to close the link; never full_access), team_access (what the team's members can do by default: full_access, comment, view or none). Folders take view or none for the link and full_access, view or none for the team (no comment). Sharing is the app's Share tab: the item's url is the link to share. Change sharing only when the user asks. A folder cannot move into itself or its subfolders, nothing moves into an asset (to make media a version use versions_update, or upload with version_of), and nothing moves between teams. Each item is applied on its own and is not undone if another fails. An item already in the requested state reports changed: {} (safe to repeat). Each result lists changed fields as [from, to], so you can revert by calling again with the from values. Needs edit access on the item and on the target folder. The user's open Flask tabs are prompted to refresh.

folder_id.description: Move into this folder, or "root" for the team's top level

id.description: Folder id, asset id or version id

link_access.description: What anyone with the link can do (comment_and_notes also reads version notes and files; none closes the link; folders: view or none)

team_access.description: What the team's members can do by default (folders: no comment)

title.description: New name of the folder or asset

version_title.description: New name of this one version (version ids only)
